status: PREPARED, NOT AUTHORISED — no image call; a batch authorisation needs a separate owner decision with capacity, one-shot claims and a send adapter
base: C (base-figure-c-v1.json); every item is generated ON C and fitted to C
replaces: pilot-plan-v2.json phase P2 (planned for a base that did not exist yet)

images: Image 1: C's raw image (sha256 10f4a4b9…), read at send time from outside both clones and verified by its hash; never tracked (precedent: D-151 sent a private base the same way) — sending C to the API is an explicit point of the batch authorisation
request.promptTemplate: Edit the stylised avatar illustration in Image 1. Keep the character exactly as it is: the same head, hair, face, expression, skin tone, body, pose, arms, hands, legs and feet, in the same position and size. Change only the clothing named here: {GARMENT}. Draw it in exactly the same painting style, outline weight and soft shading as Image 1. {COVERAGE} Do not change anything the new garment does not cover. No text, letters, numbers, logos or patterns unless named. Keep the background transparent.

coverage.top: The new top replaces the grey sleeveless top completely and covers everything it covered.
coverage.bottom: The new bottom replaces the dark grey shorts completely and covers everything they covered.
coverage.shoes: Keep the grey top and the dark grey shorts unchanged.

closed shoes around C's feet (unlike Northstar's old sneakers)

calls.rule: one call per item; a reserve call only after a TECHNICAL rejection of that item (receipt or FIT), at most one per item and three in total; no retry otherwise; an undetermined dispatch counts as sent and never triggers another send; each call its own one-shot claim

afterEachCall: store the raw response and image outside both clones with provenance
register on C (integer shift ≤ 6 px, otherwise reject — never warp)

extract: the item is every pixel that differs from C by more than 24 (D-197's changeTol) inside the category's allowed envelope, plus the base interior it must cover; a changed pixel outside the envelope (the body redrawn) rejects the item; the antialiased rim is un-mixed against C's pixel (skin or transparency); the established dust cleanup is applied, nothing is painted
split a top into topBody and sleeves by C's arm pixels
fitCheck (FIT-1 … FIT-7) and the quality measures; legacyReport is not run on new items
local review material outside the clones: the item on C, close-ups of every seam, app sizes
combinationReview: all 3 × 3 × 3 = 27 outfits from the passing items composed on C's runtime body in the contract order, at 1:1 and at the app sizes, plus the hard cases: tank + shorts + sandals (most skin), sweater + trousers + boots, tee + skirt + sneakers
success: ≥ 7 of 9 items pass FIT-1 … FIT-7 without retouching — the sleeveless top, the shorts and the sandals among them — and the owner approves the look in the 27 combinations
neverInThisPlan: publishing C or any skin layer
